samples.claim: For a decoded/borrowed sequence, inclusive row_id_range outside [needed_min,needed_max] or None skips enumeration. If allow_missing_if_nullable, ignore_field_order or allow_subschema is set, it first rejects any actual field name absent from expected, then maps actual names to (field,last_position), with duplicate names overwriting. Each expected name must compare if present; positions must be nondecreasing unless ignore_field_order. It does not enforce unique names or strict position increase; duplicate-name malformed inputs can behave differently from fast path.

samples.claim: InternCache starts Small(empty). Small scans for content equality and returns a cloned existing Arc; on miss converts Vec to Arc, inserts a clone, and promotes only when unique entries exceed16 (the17th miss). Caches grow without eviction; no interning across the two separate i32 caches. Lookup complexity is linear in unique entries and comparison length before promotion; map hashing/equality still depends on payload contents after it.
